zh.title: 波音7月交付53架飛機 累計交機量落後空中巴士
zh.summary: 波音宣布7月交付53架飛機，今年前七個月累計交機量落後空中巴士。
body: 波音於2026年8月11日宣布，該公司在2026年7月共交付了53架商用飛機。與5月的60架和6月的64架相比，其交機動能有所放緩。
與此同時，競爭對手空中巴士在7月交付了67架飛機。這使得2026年前七個月中，波音的累計交機量達到367架，而空中巴士則交付了418架。在2025年的同期，波音交付了328架噴射機。
波音7月的交付對象包括租賃公司AerCap，其獲得9架737 MAX與1架787-9。此外，聯合航空、漢莎航空、大韓航空、印度航空及Riyadh Air也分別接收了787-9。波音並在當月錄得38筆新訂單。

en.title: Boeing July 2026 Deliveries Fall Further Behind Airbus After Momentum Slows
en.summary: Boeing delivered 53 aircraft in July 2026; total deliveries fall behind rival Airbus
body: Boeing announced on August 11, 2026, that it delivered 53 commercial aircraft in July 2026. This delivery momentum slowed compared to May and June, when the manufacturer handed over 60 and 64 planes respectively.

Meanwhile, competitor Airbus delivered 67 aircraft during July 2026. This brings the seven-month delivery totals for 2026 to 367 planes for Boeing and 418 planes for Airbus. In the same period in 2025, Boeing had delivered 328 jets.

Boeing's July 2026 deliveries included nine 737 MAX aircraft and one 787-9 to lessor AerCap, while United Airlines, Lufthansa, Korean Air, Air India, and Riyadh Air also received 787-9 Dreamliners. Boeing also booked 38 new orders during the month.
